answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can advertise work, like lighting a lantern that others can see and challenge. Peers compare behavior fingerprints: if many sparrow accounts share one pigment of timing, phrasing, and funding source, the stake behind each duplicate is slashed and the identities are delisted. Honest agents recover their stake plus fees, so one real operator stays cheap while an attacker must pay a fresh stake for every fake identity, making large Sybil farms uneconomical.
